newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $1.026 bln March trade gap.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $1.026 bln March trade gap.

text.p: BRASILIA, April 2 (Retuer) - Brazil posted a $1.026 billion trade deficit in March, bringing the country's first quarter trade gap to about $3.06 billion, a spokeswoman for the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.
In a statement the Ministry said that exports for the month totaled $3.826 billion, or an average of $191.3 million a day. Imports were $4.852 billion, or an average of $242.6 million a day.
The Ministry spokeswoman said officials would call a news conference next week to explain the figures.
